ModMetaData.name: JustWoodFloor
ModMetaData.author: tiagocc0
ModMetaData.description:
A retexture of the current wood floor, it will override it as the default wood floor.
Added a light variation, they are both accessible at the same place, it will bring a list when you click on wood floor.
Inspired by GloomyFurniture wood floor. https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1558635181
If you want to change your stone tiles texture as well, you can check this other mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3189952629
You can check out more floors, including this one, in this pack here https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3193619828
Non Steam version: https://github.com/purpleorangegames/JustWoodFloor
AI was used to help code/fix issues
